description: This file defines the LoadGrain class, a grain implementation for transaction load generation and report collection in an Orleans-based project. It manages concurrent transaction creation and handles reporting of success, failure, and throttling.

classes.name: LoadGrain
classes.description: A grain class that executes transaction load generation, tracks progress, and produces a report.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Starts the load generation process asynchronously with specified parameters.

methods.name: TryGetReport
methods.description: Returns the current report if the generation task has completed.

methods.name: RunGeneration
methods.description: Core method that manages the creation of transactions, respecting concurrency limits, and measures execution time.

methods.name: ResolvePending
methods.description: Handles the completion and fault analysis of pending transaction tasks, updating the report accordingly.

methods.name: StartTransaction
methods.description: Initiates a transaction via the ITransactionRootGrain and handles transient failures.
